title: Choice of Quantum Vacuum for Inflation Observables
summary: We investigate the modifications to inflationary observables that arise when adopting an $α$-vacuum instead of the standard Bunch--Davies vacuum for quantum fluctuations during inflation. Within the Starobinsky inflationary model, we compute and compare the scalar spectral index, its running, and the running of the running arising from different choices of the initial vacuum state.
